artworks.title: A Woman Carrying Two Children in a Basket, with a Musician
artworks.medium: etching, hand-colored with watercolor, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an arrangement of curved lines forming a large, arching shape transitioning into various vibrant colors. The abstract composition blends hues of red, blue, pink, and yellow. The lines and shapes are overlaid on a textured green background. In the center, a circular form houses a brown shape with a sharp, pointed tip.

artworks.title: Man Struggling with an Ox
artworks.medium: etching, hand-colored with watercolor, on laid paper
artworks.description: Various curved lines and organic shapes intertwine in this abstract composition. A series of overlapping and elongated figures are central, draped across tree shapes. Green tree branches form a natural archway above these figures. Below, a curled, textured form resembles a resting animal. The artwork creates a surreal tableau reminiscent of dreamlike landscapes.

artworks.title: De Servi Cacciator... (Servants Preparing the Guns for the Hunt)
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Pietro Longhi
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund and Florian Carr Fund
artworks.description: The drawing depicts several figures cleaning and preparing firearms outdoors. The individuals are focused on their tasks. The background shows a rustic setting, potentially a building or shelter. The bottom of the scene includes hunting gear like game animals and a hunting bag. The monochrome effect is achieved through the use of pencil or charcoal, creating depth through gradients of grey and black.

artworks.title: Vago é mirar, come l'uman pensiero... (Shooting from the Hide)
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Pietro Longhi
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund, Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund and Florian Carr Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a wetland environment with ducks in flight and swimming in the water. Several individuals are hunting in the scene. One hunter is aiming a firearm at flying ducks, while another person is rowing a boat in the background. The artwork includes textures like rippling water, duck feathers, and foliage. The cloudy sky above adds a dramatic backdrop to the scene.

artworks.title: Young Woman Sewing
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a cushioned bench or chair. She has her body turned slightly to the side, with her head tilted downward and her eyes looking away from the viewer. Her facial features suggest a contemplative expression, and her hair is pulled back in a loose style. She is wearing a long, light blue dress with puffed sleeves and lace detailing, accentuated by a dark blue ribbon at her neck. She holds a piece of white fabric in her hands. To her side sits a small, decorative item painted in red and beige with a floral pattern. The background features a muted, textured surface in shades of brown and gray.

artworks.title: Plate Number 1. Walking
artworks.description: The image shows a series of photographs documenting a man's motion in different stages. The top row depicts him walking from left to right in profile view, the middle row shows him walking towards the camera, and the bottom row captures him walking away from the camera. The man appears unclothed and the focus is on the natural movement of his body. The background is a simple outdoor setting with a tiled or stepped pavement and a textured backdrop. The images have a sepia tone and are laid out in a grid pattern.

artworks.title: Plate Number 2. Walking
artworks.description: This is a photograph showing a sequence of images depicting a subject walking. The frames are arranged in a grid format against a lined background, suggesting a study of movement and anatomy over time. The sequence illustrates the gradual progression of walking with detailed attention to the muscular form and shifts in position of the limbs. The repeated pattern conveys a sense of time progression and focus on human motion dynamics.

artworks.title: Plate Number 3. Walking
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a series of sequential images capturing movement. The full-description shows a grid of 14 black and white photographs arranged in two rows, each depicting a different stage of a motion sequence. The top row displays images taken from the front perspective, featuring a series of movement across a consistent grid patterned background. The bottom row displays the same sequence of movement but from the rear perspective. The setting and attire suggest a careful study of form, possibly relating to kinetic art or anatomical studies, highlighting bodily movement through a series of continued and subtle shifts.

artworks.title: Plate Number 4. Walking
artworks.description: This is a photograph depicting a sequential analysis of human locomotion. The image shows a series of frames displaying a figure in motion, walking or running. The top row shows a side view sequence highlighting changes in posture and limb position as the figure moves. The backdrop includes a grid pattern. The bottom row shows a front-facing view, capturing stride and arm swing. The image offers a detailed visual study of movement likely for scientific or educational purposes.

artworks.title: Plate Number 5. Walking
artworks.description: This is a photograph of sequential motion imagery. The image depicts a series of frames capturing a person's walking motion from the side and the front. A grid in the background suggests a scientific or analytical approach to studying movement. Each frame shows a different phase of the walking cycle, illustrating the progression of steps. The top row displays a profile view, while the bottom row presents a frontal view. The overall tone of the image is monochrome.

artworks.title: Plate Number 6. Walking
artworks.description: This image contains a sequence of photographic frames capturing motion. The frames are arranged in two rows showing movement progressing from left to right. The background features a grid pattern. The figures are presented in profile, showcasing the transition of motion, potentially for a study in biomechanics or movement.

artworks.title: Plate Number 7. Walking
artworks.description: This is a series of images depicting a naked figure in motion. The images are arranged in a grid format, showing two rows of continuous motion captured from side and back perspectives. The first row shows a left side view of dynamic steps against a neutral background with a grid pattern. The second row mirrors this sequence from a rear view, maintaining consistent photographic composition in terms of placement and lighting. The images capture changes in posture and stride, freeze-framing each moment of the movement. The series emphasizes the study of human motion in a systematic, analytical manner, indicative of an early form of motion photography meant to understand biomechanics.

artworks.title: Plate Number 8. Walking
artworks.description: This is a photograph depicting sequential frames of walking movement. The image has two rows showing side and rear views of a walking figure against a grid background. The frames capture the motion in small increments from left to right, with lighting emphasizing the movement and anatomy.

artworks.title: Plate Number 9. Walking
artworks.description: The image shows two rows of black-and-white sequential photographs of a fully nude male figure in motion. The first row depicts the man walking from left to right in a profile view, showcasing his entire body with each step. The second row continues the sequence from a rear view, showing his back as he walks away from the camera. The man has short, dark hair and slightly visible facial features. He is not wearing any clothing or accessories. The background features a grid-like structure and a contrasting floor surface.

artworks.title: Plate Number 10. Walking
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a sequence showing motion. The image displays a series of still images in a grid format capturing phases of human locomotion. Each frame shows the figure in slightly different positions, illustrating the movement of walking. The background consists of vertical lines and consistent lighting, emphasizing the motion of the subject. The sequence is organized systematically to showcase the dynamics of movement.

artworks.title: Plate Number 12. Walking
artworks.description: This is a photograph of sequential images of figures walking. The work consists of a series of black and white images, each capturing successive moments of motion. The photos are arranged in a grid pattern, with the top two rows displaying side views of figures in stride and the lower rows presenting frontal views of the same action. The backdrop reveals a lined grid against which the figures' movements are measured. This format appears to explore the mechanics of walking and movement through a systematic photographic study, emphasizing the progression in each frame and the fluidity of human motion.

artworks.title: Plate Number 13. Walking
artworks.description: The image displays a series of photographs capturing a person walking in different stages from side, front, and back perspectives across multiple frames in a grid pattern. The individual is shown in motion, with short hair and indistinct facial features. They are unclothed, with no visible accessories. The background features simple settings like horizontal and vertical lines, appearing to be a fence or wall, with concrete ground. The environment seems to be outdoors with uniform lighting, typical of motion studies.

artworks.title: Plate Number 14. Walking, right hand at chin
artworks.description: The image shows a series of photographs of a nude person walking in sequential poses. The top row displays the person in profile, walking from right to left with their right hand raised towards their face. The middle row shows the person from the rear, walking from left to right. The bottom row depicts the person facing forward, walking from left to right with their hand raised towards their face. The background features a striped, textured wall and there are no other elements visible.

artworks.title: Plate Number 15. Walking
artworks.description: The image displays sequential photographs of a person walking. Each frame shows the person in full body view, captured mid-step. The person's head is turned slightly to the side in the top row, with short hair styled close to the scalp. They are nude and not wearing any jewelry or holding anything. The background features a grid pattern, potentially for measurement, in an indoor setting with even lighting.

artworks.title: Plate Number 16. Walking
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a sequential motion study. The image consists of multiple black and white panels arranged in three rows, documenting the stages of a figure walking. The background features a lined or gridded pattern that helps accentuate the movement captured in the panels. Each frame captures minute changes in the figure's position, creating a sense of dynamic motion when viewed collectively.

artworks.title: Plate Number 17. Walking
artworks.description: This is a photograph showcasing sequential motion capturing. The image consists of a series of consecutive frames split into two rows. The frames depict a person walking against a grid-patterned outdoor backdrop. The top row shows a side view of the subject walking from left to right, while the bottom row displays a front-facing view of the person walking toward the camera. The sequential photographs enable a detailed analysis of gait and movement in a stop-motion style, similar to early motion studies focusing on locomotion.

artworks.title: Plate Number 18. Walking, left hand across abdomen
artworks.description: The image shows a sequence of plates depicting a woman walking. In each frame, the woman's movement is captured, showing different stages of her steps. She is seen in full-body shots from various angles as she moves forward. The woman's stance changes slightly with each frame. She has short, wavy hair and neutral facial expressions. The woman is nude and holds an object in some frames. The background consists of textured and smooth surfaces, possibly a wall and a flat ground surface.

artworks.title: Plate Number 19. Walking, commencing to turn around
artworks.description: The image is a composite of multiple photographs displaying a full-body view of a person shown in various positions while walking. The person is depicted from different angles, including side, front, and back, demonstrating a sequence of movement. The person has short hair, and their facial features are consistent across the images, with expressions not prominently visible due to the scale and focus on movement. The person is unclothed, and there are no visible items of jewelry or objects being held. The background consists of a grid-like structure, possibly indicative of an indoor setting used for study or documentation purposes.
